lines: Blockout round 1 is answered and failed: the film sheets scored 8, the cameras and screens 5, against a bar of 7 with nothing severe open. Eight issues, three of them severe

Fixed already: the spring move stops short of the base so the miniature stays in the frame (decision 34), and the globe now lifts 13.5 mm with the hero camera aimed lower, so the foot of the base stands 4.2 percent above the bottom edge instead of 1.7 (decision 35)

Under way with three engineers until about 08:25 UTC: the cameras surface, interior, low and macro framed again from rendered candidates; 7 percent of room between the globe and the controls on the two wide screens; every storm thinned within its first bar
Then round 2, the last blockout round the config allows. The published app is still the 04:43 build; it is published again after the fixes are merged
phase 2: 4.42 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 5.61 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Round 1: the six cameras on the stand-in globe, each beside its target (hero, macro, interior; base, surface, low). Four are being framed again
Round 1: the three screens. On the two wide ones the foot of the base stands 28 and 23 pixels above the Shake control
The spring hold after decision 34: the move stops 55 percent of the way to the base (frame 1044). The petals still hide the miniature for nine seconds; being fixed

What the first critic called severe: in the spring hold the camera sinks all the way to the base and the miniature leaves the frame for about 2.5 s. Being fixed: the move stops where the cottage and the trunk stay in (by root)
